caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a lid, decorated with elaborate, colorful folk art painting. The front panel is divided into three sections: the two outer sections each feature a large yellow oval with a blue four-petal pinwheel-like design in the center, surrounded by stylized red flowers, green stems, and two tall, red and yellow columns. The middle section contains an arched yellow panel with red and green decorative shapes, topped by a small red horse and displaying text: “Davit keonie thomas 1786.” The chest’s background appears dark blue or black, contrasting with the vivid yellow, red, green, and light blue patterns. The border along the bottom is decorated with circular and scroll designs in white, red, and blue. The front legs of the chest are curved and painted yellow, and the artist's name “BETTY JEAN DAVIS” is written in red at the lower right of the drawing.
title: Pennsylvania German Chest
